title: fix(plugin-list): a sourced list shows each condition once, and a lookup chip names its record
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgRuogP8Tp8XyFXLc92Bxvo6)_

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me

Fixes #35727

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化:从记录「↗」打开的列表(数据页),条件只在页面顶部的「筛选条件」标签里出现一次;列表自己的条件行不再重复一个带锁、印着原始 id 的标签,也不再多出一个灰掉的「重置」。保存视图里锁定的关联字段条件,改为显示记录名称。
- 为什么做:列表筛选重做这条线上的一项,替从关联页签跳到列表的用户去掉重复的条件和多余的「重置」。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是数据页上某个条件看不到标签,或关联记录名读不到时退回显示 id;筛选本身照常生效,撤回这个改动即可复原。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

- **Host-owned conditions (the seam).** `ListView` takes a new host prop, `hostDrawnConditionFields` (a list of field names). Conditions of `schema.filter` on those fields still constrain the query exactly as before; the condition row (`ConditionChipRow`, new prop `hostDrawnFields`) simply draws no locked chip for them. The data page passes its address-condition fields there, so a sourced open shows each condition once, as the page's own 「Filtered by」 tag.
  - Why this seam rather than a separate "host filter" channel: the view filter (`authoredFilter`) feeds the fetch, the page-reset signature, the export, the self-querying child views, the empty-state copy and Save-as-view. Moving the address conditions out of `schema.filter` would have to re-thread every one of those readers; naming which fields the host draws changes only what the chip row renders, and the query path is byte-identical. It is a host prop, never a schema key: which surface draws a condition is the page's layout, not anything an author writes.
- **Lookup chips name the record.** A locked chip for a lookup condition (and the reader's own lookup filter chip, same code path) shows the referenced record's name, read the way the lookup value picker reads it: the target's records by id through the list's data source (`find(target, { $filter: { id: { $in: ids } } })`), named by the lookup's `displayField` else the target's name field (`referencedRecordTitle`). It falls back to the id only when the name cannot be read. One read per target, re-run only when the targets or ids change (keyed on content, not on array identity).
- **One Reset.** The condition row's 「Reset」 is drawn only while the reader has something of their own to reset (a filter, a changed sort, a filter-bar selection, the queue toggle) — it is no longer drawn disabled. `ConditionChipRow`'s `resetDisabled` prop is gone; `ListView` passes `onReset` only when the conditions differ from the view.
- **Data page:** only the props passed to `ListView` changed — one added prop, `hostDrawnConditionFields={urlFilters.map(([field]) => field)}`, plus its comment, right after `rowOpensRecord={recordServed}`. The page's tag row is untouched (it belongs to the open PR #35725 for the related tab, which adds the page's own Reset and names the tag).

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/conditions/ListConditionControls.tsx` — `useLookupValueNames` (the one read the chip row now makes) and the `hostDrawnFields` filter on `viewChips`.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — the `ConditionChipRow` call site (`onReset={conditionsDifferFromView ? handleResetConditions : undefined}`).
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.tsx` — the one added `ListView` prop.

Two-minute check: open the showcase Contacts data page with `filter[account]=` set to any account id (or an account's Contacts tab → 「↗」). Expect one 「筛选条件 · 客户」 tag at the top, no row of chips under the view bar, and the record count matching that account. Add a 阶段 filter: its chip, 「+ 添加筛选」 and one enabled 「重置」 appear.

## Tests

All at merged head `eae54db249` (after merging `origin/main` at `03bce5c22a`).

- List level, `ConditionChipRow` (`listConditions.test.tsx`): a host-drawn field gets no locked chip while the view's other conditions keep theirs (with a CONTROL without the prop); all-host-drawn and nothing else ⇒ the row draws nothing; a locked lookup chip reads `Account: = Globex` and the read is `find('account', { $top: 1, $filter: { id: { $in: ['a1'] } } })`; the reader's lookup chip reads `Account: Globex, Initech`; a failing read keeps the id. The Reset pin now asserts no Reset is drawn when the host passes none.
- List level, real `ListView` (`ListView.harness.test.tsx`, new block `ListView.hostDrawnConditions-35727`), zh and en each: a host-drawn condition is no locked chip and no Reset and the record query still carries it; a saved view filtered on a lookup locks `Account：= Globex` / `Account: = Globex`, never the id, and draws no Reset; once the reader adds a condition, exactly one Reset (`重置` / `Reset`). `ListView.conditionRow-35549.test.tsx`: the locked-chip case now asserts no Reset rather than a disabled one.
- Data-page level, real page with the real `ListView` (`ObjectDataPage.sourcedOpenOneTag-35727.test.tsx`), zh and en: `filter[account]=acc_1` draws one page tag, zero locked chips, no list Reset, and the record query still carries `acc_1`; CONTROL: no address condition ⇒ no tag and an unfiltered read.

<details><summary>Run readings</summary>

- Touched suites: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over `plugin-list/src/conditions/`, `ListView.harness`, `ListView.conditionRow-35549`, `ListView.clearFiltersChips-29052`, `ListView.emptyStateClearFilters-28908` and the seven `ObjectDataPage.*` tests → `Test Files 12 passed (12)`, `Tests 246 passed (246)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list run type-check` → exit 0 (after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`, 68/68 tasks).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` → exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` → `Test Files 171 passed | 2 skipped`, `Tests 5092 passed | 2 skipped`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one per changed behaviour; each via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, mutation proven on disk, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

1. Drop the data page's `hostDrawnConditionFields` prop → both data-page cases red (a locked chip appears); CONTROL stays green.
2. Replace the `hostDrawnFields` filter with a pass-through → 6 red (two `ConditionChipRow` cases, the four host-drawn `ListView` cases).
3. Disable the lookup-name branch of `describeConditionValue` → 4 red (two `ConditionChipRow` name cases, the zh/en saved-view lookup cases).
4. Always pass `onReset` → 3 red (the zh/en saved-view cases and the 35549 locked-chip case). The data-page no-Reset case stays green under this one by design: with every condition host-drawn and nothing of the reader's, the row draws nothing at all.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Before/after in the browser (showcase, 1280×800, zh-CN, Contacts data page with `filter[account]` = Northwind's id):
  - before at `origin/main` `5ecf937470`: page tags 1 (「客户 = Pf5mgR55cgCKt58S」), locked chips 1 (「客户：= Pf5mgR55cgCKt58S」), list Reset 1 (drawn, disabled), 「+ 添加筛选」 1;
  - after: page tags 1, locked chips 0, list Reset 0, condition row empty; 26 records either way. Adding a 阶段 filter: 「阶段：新建」, 「+ 添加筛选」, one enabled 「重置」, 24 records. A reader 客户 filter reads 「客户：Northwind」.
- On `main` alone the sourced data page now shows no Reset at all (the page tag's × still clears the condition); the open PR #35725 for the related tab adds the page's single Reset and names the page tag. Whichever of the two lands second merges `main`; `overlap-check` against `main` and against that PR's branch both answer clean.
- The Reset rule is general, not only on the data page: every list now draws 「Reset」 only while it has something of the reader's to reset (previously drawn disabled). The e2e scenario in `list-condition-row-35549.spec.ts` presses Reset only after adding a sort and a filter, so it is unaffected.
- A `user`-type lookup with no declared `reference` still prints its id in a chip: the value picker defaults such a field to `users` inline, and this change reads only a declared `referenceTo` rather than copying that default.
- The plugin-list README documents some `ListView` host props (`rowOpensRecord`, `page`); the new `hostDrawnConditionFields` is documented on the prop's own JSDoc and in the changeset, not in the README, which is outside this card's file surface.
- The data-page test holds its permission and auth stand-ins as stable objects: the page keys its address conditions on `canRead`, so a fresh function per render (as the sibling tests' stand-ins return, harmless there because they stub `ListView`) re-reads the records without end.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (tree `f64696e915`, re-derived identical at the final tree): 38 families, all run locally, all exit 0 after one fix — `check:test-source-alias` first flagged the new data-page test for reaching a dynamic `import('@objectstack/lint')`; the test now pays that load at module top, and the gate is green. `--ran` reconciliation: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The one `vitest run scripts/` run that was killed by the box's memory limit was re-run alone and passed.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` → 0 new citations. Control-byte self-scan over the diff: no hits. `eslint` over the changed files: 0 errors.
- Every family CI runs on this PR (Lint & Repo Gates, Type Check UI, Test UI, Build & E2E UI, and the rest) is read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.
